verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documented way to schedule recurring jobs or workflows in Dynamics 365 Sales. A generic claim about the ability to 'automate business processes' and autonomous agent behavior is not a recurring schedule. The Web API items are developer building blocks for one-off operations, not scheduling. Recurring scheduling is a fair axis for a CRM, so this is 'none' rather than 'na'.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
